policy_freeze.nopat: operating profit bridge; never net profit or parent-attributable profit
policy_freeze.invested_capital: parent equity plus NCI plus scope-matched interest-bearing debt and leases less only evidenced qualifying non-operating assets
policy_freeze.tax: direct operating tax required; current/deferred reconciliation is evidence, not a fallback
policy_freeze.cash: purpose-classified cash only; never silently subtract all cash
policy_freeze.pit: latest visible canonical version at or before assessment_as_of
policy_freeze.restatement: strict supersedes chain; conflicting disconnected chains are unresolved
policy_freeze.opening_balance: FY2020 opening is not fabricated; FY2021+ requires prior FY end balance
